  • Implementar e gerenciar dashboards e processos que forneçam visibilidade em tempo real sobre a eficiência dos recursos de nuvem e custos associados.
  • Colaborar com equipes de TI e áreas de negócio para promover uma cultura de colaboração interfuncional e responsabilidade financeira.

O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência em gestão de custos de nuvem e otimização de recursos (FinOps).
  • Conhecimento em SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), Microsoft Power BI e Excel avançado.
  • Experiência com sistemas SAP ECC, S/4HANA e SAP HANA (desejável).
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e colaboração.
  • Fluência em inglês, tanto escrito quanto falado.
  • Criatividade, inovação e atenção à qualidade do trabalho.
  • Adaptabilidade a prazos apertados e mudanças de prioridade.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Key Account Manager
description:
Job Title: VIP Account Manager

Location: Brazil -Remote

************ *Note - PLEASE ONLY APPLY IF YOU HAVE IGAMING EXPERIENCE ******************

Our client, a well-known Brazilian gambling operator, is looking for a motivated VIP Account Manager to assist in managing and growing the VIP customer segment to help and assist the current VIP team in place.

This role will focus on building strong client relationships, supporting engagement strategies, and helping improve the overall VIP experience. It's a great opportunity for someone with account management experience who wants to develop their skills in a dynamic industry.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Assist in identifying and onboarding new VIP clients through prospecting and networking.
  • Support the management of VIP client relationships, ensuring high levels of satisfaction.
  • Help execute engagement and retention strategies to increase player loyalty.
  • Work closely with senior team members to design and implement and improve VIP incentives, promotions, and personalized offers.
  • Monitor key performance metrics such as betting volume, customer acquisition cost (CAC), retention rates, and customer lifetime value (LTV).
  • Assist in preparing reports on VIP performance and account development.
  • Ensure compliance with responsible gaming and company policies.

Skills & Qualifications :

  • Experience in account management, sales, or customer service, preferably in the betting or online gaming industry.
  • A wallet or existing player base would be incredibly valuable and sought after.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills to build client relationships.
  • Basic knowledge of sports betting and online casino market is a plus.
  • Comfortable working with data and reports to understand customer behavior.
  • Proficiency in MS Office and CRM tools.
  • Ability to work flexible hours when needed.

This role is ideal for someone eager to grow in VIP management, with the opportunity to learn from experienced professionals in the field and business.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
The Senior Machine Learning Engineer owns the development and deployment of machine learning solutions and influences the technical direction of their team. They will work closely with Product and Engineering partners in the development of the solution.

  • Lead the development and deployment of Machine Learning solutions to solve business problems.
  • Develop and maintain clean, efficient, and scalable code that meets industry standards
  • Analyze large datasets to extract actionable insights and make informed decisions.
  • Employ state-of-the-art Machine Learning methodologies and frameworks to develop robust and scalable models.
  • Influence technical direction and take ownership of key components of systems and solutions, ensuring that they meet the needs of the business.
  • Collaborate with key stakeholders in the development of data-driven solutions and deployable products.
  • Mentor junior team members to help establish team domain expertise.
  • Contribute to the companys intellectual property and technical leadership through patents and publications at top-tier conferences and journals.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning
  • Masters Degree or PhD in CS / ML or related field
  • 3+ years experience in building, deploying, and managing machine learning and deep learning models in production environments at scale
  • Deep understanding of ML best practices (A/B testing, training/serving pipelines, feature engineering etc), algorithms/techniques (gradient boosting, deep neural networks, optimization, regularization), and experiment design
  • Experience in at least one of these domains: price estimation, personalization, recommender systems, computer vision, fraud detection and authentication, marketing
  • Extensive experience in scientific libraries in Python (numpy, pandas) and Machine Learning tools and frameworks (Scikit-Learn, Tensorflow, Keras, PyTorch)
  • Strong data engineering skills and experience working with large scale datasets
  • Experience with big data tools (Apache Beam, Apache Kafka, Spark)
  • Experience with cloud technologies AWS, GCP or Azure

Fluency in Python, SQL

Preferred Requirements:

  • PhD preferred (CS, ML, AI or related field)
  • Background in applying ML techniques to solve real-world business problems in the retail sector.
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and pipelines.
  • Impact-focused and passionate about delivering high-quality models.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience, with the ability to lead and inspire a team.

title: Software Engineer
description:
About us

Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to join a fast-growing fintech company that is revolutionizing the payment industry? Do you want to work with cutting-edge technologies and a talented team of professionals? If yes, then Wallester AS might be the perfect place for you!

Wallester AS is an Estonian licensed payment service provider that develops financial digital technology and issues VISA cards. Since 2018, we have been an official Visa partner and Visa FinTech Fast Track Member issuing physical and virtual cards of any type: debit cards, credit cards, prepaid cards, and cards for business. Our distinctive advantage is a unique REST API created by our in-house development team. Easily integrated with any platform, it allows you to launch your card program in no time!

We are looking for passionate and driven individuals who share our vision of creating truly high-quality and profitable products for our clients.

About the role

As a Software Engineer at Wallester, you will play a key role in developing and maintaining our unique platform that enables our clients to launch their card programs in no time. You will be involved in all stages of the software development life cycle, from planning and analysis to deployment and maintenance. You will also have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies and a talented team of professionals.

If you are passionate about FinTech and payment solutions, have excellent technical skills, and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, then this role is for you!

Location

We are seeking Software Engineering specialists to join Wallester's headquarters in Tallinn (Golden Gate, Rotermanni Quarter) and our Latvian office in Riga (Jupiter Tower).

Technology stack

  • Golang
  • gRPC
  • Protocol Buffers
  • PostgreSQL
  • Redis
  • JSON REST API
  • Docker
  • Kubernetes
  • Linkerd
  • AWS infrastructure
  • Microservice Architecture

What will you do?

  • Participate in the whole software development life cycle
  • Write high-quality, efficient, and maintainable code that follows company standards
  • Collaborate with Engineers across the company to build new features
  • Actively contribute to adopting best practices in Software Engineering, improvement of processes, and team culture

What you'll need

  • 3+ years of experience in software development using any OOP language (C# / Java / PHP / JavaScript / etc.)
  • Experience with microservice architecture, REST API, RPC, PostgreSQL, and Docker
  • You have good English and communication skills
  • Experience working with agile software development teams
  • Problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to work independently and proactively

Nice to have

  • Experience in working with cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure)
  • Skilled in applying CI/CD infrastructure for software development and delivery
  • Experience in test methodologies and frameworks
  • Experience in financial software development
  • Knowledge of security best practices and standards (OWASP, PCI DSS)
  • Also, a spark in the eyes is always a plus!

We offer

  • Competitive salary
  • Development and career opportunities
  • Medical Insurance upon the completion of the probationary period
  • Supportive and caring Leadership
  • A modern office in the city center (Tallinn: Golden Gate and Riga: Jupiter Tower).
  • A chance to work as part of a highly motivated and talented team
  • Referral program
  • Stebby
  • Team buildings and Company Events
  • Free parking

title: Arquiteto SAP CI-DS (Cloud Integration - Data Services) - Remoto
description:
Vaga: Arquiteto SAP CI-DS (Cloud Integration - Data Services) – Remoto

Modelo de contratação: PJ

Início: 10/2025

Prazo: 12 meses

Horário de Trabalho: 13:00 às 22:00 fuso horário do Brasil

Local da vaga: Remoto

Idioma: Fluente

Conhecimentos técnicos requeridos:

  • Formação superior completa (ex: Engenharia ou correlatas na área de tecnologia);
  • 5+ anos de experiência em SAP CPI-DS/CI-DS;
  • Proficiência funcional/técnica com pelo menos 3 implementações SAP IBP de ciclo de vida completo;
  • Proficiente em analisar e traduzir requisitos de negócios para requisitos técnicos e arquitetura

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Projetar, criar, implantar e dar suporte a soluções SAP CI-DS especificamente para SAP Integrated Business Planning (IBP).
  • Suporte aos requisitos de integração para os módulos SAP IBP Demand Planning e SAP IBP Response & Supply.
  • Análise e traduza os requisitos de negócios em requisitos técnicos e arquitetura.
  • Realizar integrações ETL de SAP CI-DS/CPI-DS com sistemas SAP e não SAP.
  • Instale e configure o agente CI-DS.
  • Aprimore BADIs e extratores IBP.
  • Crie extratores IBP personalizados.

Habilidades comportamentais: Comunicação interpessoais e trabalho em equipe;

Vaga: Arquiteto SAP CI-DS (Cloud Integration - Data Services) – Remoto

Modelo de contratação: PJ

Início: 10/2025

Prazo: 12 meses

Horário de Trabalho: 13:00 às 22:00 fuso horário do Brasil

Local da vaga: Remoto

Idioma: Fluente

Conhecimentos técnicos requeridos:

  • Formação superior completa (ex: Engenharia ou correlatas na área de tecnologia);
  • 5+ anos de experiência em SAP CPI-DS/CI-DS;
  • Proficiência funcional/técnica com pelo menos 3 implementações SAP IBP de ciclo de vida completo;
  • Proficiente em analisar e traduzir requisitos de negócios para requisitos técnicos e arquitetura

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Projetar, criar, implantar e dar suporte a soluções SAP CI-DS especificamente para SAP Integrated Business Planning (IBP).
  • Suporte aos requisitos de integração para os módulos SAP IBP Demand Planning e SAP IBP Response & Supply.
  • Análise e traduza os requisitos de negócios em requisitos técnicos e arquitetura.
  • Realizar integrações ETL de SAP CI-DS/CPI-DS com sistemas SAP e não SAP.
  • Instale e configure o agente CI-DS.
  • Aprimore BADIs e extratores IBP.
  • Crie extratores IBP personalizados.

Habilidades comportamentais: Comunicação interpessoais e trabalho em equipe;

title: Business Development Manager (LATAM)
description:
Bitunix is expanding across LATAM region and building a team of professional Business Development Managers who will play a key role in driving user growth and becoming essential partners in the company's success.

Responsibilities:

  • Drive user growth and expand Bitunix's presence in LATAM market through strategic partnerships and influencer collaborations.
  • Identify, engage, and develop relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), influencers, and relevant partners to accelerate business expansion.
  • Manage and strengthen existing partnerships and user communities.
  • Collaborate with potential investors and organizations to explore new business opportunities and promote the Bitunix brand.

Requirements:

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in Business Development, focusing on partnerships, influencer/KOL management, or user acquisition.
  • Deep understanding of the LATAM crypto market and its key players.
  • Proven record of achieving or exceeding growth and partnership goals.
  • Strong passion for the crypto and blockchain industry.
  • Self-driven, detail-oriented, and result-focused professional able to work independently.
  • Fluent in English.

title: Senior Frontend Developer
description:
Senior Frontend Developer (Brazil-Based)

Permanent or freelance contract

We're hiring on behalf of an innovative client building a cutting-edge platform that streamlines and automates data workflows for enterprise teams. Their product is designed to simplify complex data pipelines, making it easier for teams to collaborate, deploy, and scale data-driven solutions rapidly.

They're now looking for a Senior Frontend Developer to join their growing team in Brazil and help shape the user experience of this powerful platform.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain high-quality, responsive UIs using React, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS
  • Collaborate with backend engineers and designers to deliver seamless user experiences
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and frontend best practices
  • Help evolve the product's design system and improve usability

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of professional experience post-graduation (ideally more)
  • Strong proficiency in React, TypeScript, HTML/CSS
  • Solid understanding of full-stack fundamentals: SQL, PHP/Laravel, AWS
  • Background in 3D, AR/VR, or CAD/CAM products is a big plus
  • A keen eye for UI/UX design and responsive layouts
  • Based in Brazil, to collaborate closely with the local and international teams

This is a unique opportunity to contribute to a ground-breaking product alongside international teams. The role can be structured as either a permanent or freelance contract, with flexibility based on your preference.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Golang)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Software Engineer with 8 to 12 years of software programming experience, including a strong background in Golang, Kubernetes, major cloud platforms, and CI/CD. You will fully automate provisioning, deployment, management, and monitoring for a rapidly evolving and highly scalable set of SaaS services. You will work with members of the DevOps team alongside a DevOps architect to ensure best practices are implemented across applications, lead teams in the direction of initiatives, such as CI/CD and enterprise monitoring, and work on support services operational on the cloud.

You are the ideal candidate if you enjoy improving engineering efficiency, mentoring junior team members, promoting best practices, and solving problems by digging into the technical details.

Our client was named a Top 25 Cybersecurity Company by The Software Report and one of Inc. Magazine's Best Places to Work in 2020. The company is a leader in cloud-based networking and security services. Their services empower organizations to optimize cloud usage, delivering network experiences that are simple, scalable, and reliable. The client counts 70% of the Fortune 500 companies as customers.

Responsibilities

  • Develop, design, and maintain features that empower developer productivity
  • Design and implement components of the client's next-generation, internal developer platform
  • Recommend ways to improve system reliability, efficiency, and quality
  • Work closely with various cross-functional product teams
  • Stay up-to-date on key trends, especially in the area of technologies and frameworks like Kubernetes, Docker, ELK/Prometheus, and more
  • Own platform engineering
  • Develop REST APIs and contribute to the overall API framework
  • Use multiple open software to build a developer platform

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 8 to 12 years of experience in software development using programming languages
  • Experience with Golang, including building API and web services
  • Experience with DevOps technologies and methodologies, including Kubernetes, major cloud platforms (preferably AWS), and CI/CD
  • Solid understanding of microservices architecture and container-based software, such as Docker
  • Experience developing microservices and using Cloud Services API
  • Strong focus on reliability and security
  • Solid exposure to application performance tuning, memory management, and scalability
  • Ability to design highly scalable distributed systems using different open-source technologies

Desired Experience

  • University degree or equivalent educational experience (preferably in a STEM field)
  • Additional container technologies besides Docker and Kubernetes
  • Experience with Amazon Web Services, such as EC2, VPC, ELB, S3, and CloudFormation, or equivalent services in GCP and/or Azure

Additional Info

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter – think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual – no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer - Node.js (remoto)
description:
Nosso cliente global em rastreamento de CCU busca Engenheiro(a) Sênior Fullstack (React + Node.js) para modernizar sua plataforma. Papel essencial em novos recursos, escalabilidade e boas práticas, atuando em infraestrutura AWS com foco em rastreabilidade e dados críticos. Vaga 100% remota, modelo de contratação é CLT. Inglês avançado obrigatório (interlocução com US).

O que procuramos:

O time de Engenharia busca Engenheiro(a) Sênior de Software para modernizar a plataforma e elevar a experiência do usuário. Atuação em novos recursos, escalabilidade e práticas de engenharia, desenvolvendo soluções em AWS que garantem dados e funcionalidades críticas aos clientes.

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver, manter e aprimorar uma plataforma de rastreamento de ativos resiliente, confiável e altamente disponível.
  • Fornecer liderança técnica por meio do conhecimento e compreensão de design e arquitetura de software.
  • Aplicar práticas ágeis, incentivando a colaboração, priorização e urgência para um desenvolvimento acelerado.
  • Contribuir para a visão da equipe de Software, ajudando a evoluir práticas e ferramentas.
  • Construir parcerias multidisciplinares com gerentes de produto, engenheiros de dados, sistemas e qualidade, além de parceiros de negócios, para desenvolver funcionalidades para os clientes.
  • Buscar diferentes perspectivas para impulsionar a inovação e construir consenso dentro da organização de engenharia de software.

Conhecimentos e Habilidades:

  • Experiência sólida com JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de aplicativos móveis híbridos para criar aplicações intuitivas e compatíveis com múltiplas plataformas.
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD, GitLab, Docker, AWS e Postgres.
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de APIs REST, GraphQL, micro frontends e microsserviços.
  • Familiaridade com o ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de software, incluindo definição de padrões, revisão de código, automação de testes, processos de build, monitoramento e alertas.
  • Capacidade de atuar com alto grau de autonomia, ao mesmo tempo em que trabalha em iniciativas estratégicas para a empresa.
  • Experiência com sistemas transacionais de alta demanda, onde desempenho e escalabilidade são essenciais.
  • Facilidade para aprender e se adaptar a novas tecnologias, auxiliando na transição para novas soluções.
  • Inglês Fluente
  • Experiência com a metodologia ágil Scrum em um ambiente de equipe distribuída.
  • Conhecimento em IoT, dispositivos de rastreamento e telemática é um diferencial.
  • Conhecimento em Ruby on Rails é um diferencial.

Formação e Experiência:

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.
  • 7+ anos de experiência na área de Engenharia de Software.
  • Experiência demonstrada no desenvolvimento end-to-end de software, incluindo propriedade operacional.

title: Analista Ciência da Medição Pleno
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!

Buscamos: Analista Ciência da Medição Pleno

Resumo:

Pessoa será responsável por garantir a manutenção dos produtos e processos correntes, atuando também continuamente em busca de melhorias metodológicas, processuais e em qualidade. Além disso, se posiciona como ponto focal para atendimento de dúvidas dos times de Produto, Operações e Comercial, suportando também testes, documentações e estudos de novos processos.

O que você irá fazer:

  • Promover a contínua comunicação com os principais stakeholders internos para a manutenção dos critérios técnicos na sustentabilidade dos processos recorrentes nos produtos.
  • Garantir em metodologia e execução a manutenção de processos já validados e em operação nos produtos em que o time possui atuação.
  • Atuar nas inclusões, revisões e atualizações metodológicas propostas pelo time e/ou demandadas por Produto e Comercial dos processos relacionados com métodos de integração de dados para os produtos do Portfólio.
  • Mapear, desenvolver e apoiar o desenvolvimento de análises e testes de novos processos dos produtos de Audiência de TV e Cross Media.
  • Propor e desenvolver controles de qualidade com o objetivo de garantir e certificar o pleno funcionamento de etapas de processos internos e/ou externos associados aos produtos e cobertos pelo escopo do time.
  • Mapear oportunidades em que a automação pode promover melhora significativa na qualidade e/ ou eficiência de processos.
  • Propor e desenvolver técnicas e aplicações de automação para atividades recorrentes na equipe ou executadas por áreas de interface e que impactem os processos da equipe.
  • Monitorar de forma contínua o mercado de Inteligência Artificial, com objetivo de identificar e implementar soluções que visem inovação, melhoria e/ou eficiência.
  • Fomentar de forma constante a inovação e melhoria contínua em temas relacionados à área, estando constantemente ativo na busca e curadoria de novas práticas e aberto a ouvir propostas de outros membros da equipe.
  • Contribuir para o crescimento de cada membro da equipe, estando sempre disponível para troca de ideias, explicações e compartilhamento de conhecimento.

O que buscamos?

  • Formação Superior em Estatística, Matemática ou áreas correlatas.
  • Desejável experiência na indústria de publicidade e/ou mídia.
  • Fundamental experiência em linguagens de programação como Python e R.
  • Desejável conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização de dados integradas ao Python, R ou como o Power BI.
  • Desejável conhecimento em plataformas para uso de dados em nuvem, como Azure Databricks.
  • Desejável conhecimento e interesse em soluções acionáveis de Inteligência Artificial para negócios e dados.
  • Inglês intermediário fundamental, para leitura, escrita e conversação.
  • Espanhol desejável.

O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:

  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Previdência Privada
  • Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses
  • Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, ginastica laboral com profissional de educação física toda semana, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe; Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: a Kantar valoriza seus talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua

Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!

Na Kantar IBOPE Media, a diversidade faz parte do negócio, gerando inovação e resultados. Não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, nacionalidade, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência, gravidez, estado civil ou qualquer outra forma de discriminação.

title: Analista Ciência da Medição Pleno
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!

Buscamos: Analista Ciência da Medição Pleno

Resumo:

Pessoa será responsável por garantir a manutenção dos produtos e processos correntes, atuando também continuamente em busca de melhorias metodológicas, processuais e em qualidade. Além disso, se posiciona como ponto focal para atendimento de dúvidas dos times de Produto, Operações e Comercial, suportando também testes, documentações e estudos de novos processos.

O que você irá fazer:

  • Promover a contínua comunicação com os principais stakeholders internos para a manutenção dos critérios técnicos na sustentabilidade dos processos recorrentes nos produtos.
  • Garantir em metodologia e execução a manutenção de processos já validados e em operação nos produtos em que o time possui atuação.
  • Atuar nas inclusões, revisões e atualizações metodológicas propostas pelo time e/ou demandadas por Produto e Comercial dos processos relacionados com métodos de integração de dados para os produtos do Portfólio.
  • Mapear, desenvolver e apoiar o desenvolvimento de análises e testes de novos processos dos produtos de Audiência de TV e Cross Media.
  • Propor e desenvolver controles de qualidade com o objetivo de garantir e certificar o pleno funcionamento de etapas de processos internos e/ou externos associados aos produtos e cobertos pelo escopo do time.
  • Mapear oportunidades em que a automação pode promover melhora significativa na qualidade e/ ou eficiência de processos.
  • Propor e desenvolver técnicas e aplicações de automação para atividades recorrentes na equipe ou executadas por áreas de interface e que impactem os processos da equipe.
  • Monitorar de forma contínua o mercado de Inteligência Artificial, com objetivo de identificar e implementar soluções que visem inovação, melhoria e/ou eficiência.
  • Fomentar de forma constante a inovação e melhoria contínua em temas relacionados à área, estando constantemente ativo na busca e curadoria de novas práticas e aberto a ouvir propostas de outros membros da equipe.
  • Contribuir para o crescimento de cada membro da equipe, estando sempre disponível para troca de ideias, explicações e compartilhamento de conhecimento.

O que buscamos?

  • Formação Superior em Estatística, Matemática ou áreas correlatas.
  • Desejável experiência na indústria de publicidade e/ou mídia.
  • Fundamental experiência em linguagens de programação como Python e R.
  • Desejável conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização de dados integradas ao Python, R ou como o Power BI.
  • Desejável conhecimento em plataformas para uso de dados em nuvem, como Azure Databricks.
  • Desejável conhecimento e interesse em soluções acionáveis de Inteligência Artificial para negócios e dados.
  • Inglês intermediário fundamental, para leitura, escrita e conversação.
  • Espanhol desejável.

O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:

  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Previdência Privada
  • Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses
  • Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos

  • Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, ginastica laboral com profissional de educação física toda semana, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe; Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: a Kantar valoriza seus talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua

title: Projetista elétrico
description:
Requisitos:

Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia Elétrica ou áreas correlatas;

Conhecimento em AutoCAD e Revit;

Diferencial: Experiência com projetos elétricos industriais;

Habilidade para interpretar e elaborar projetos conforme especificações técnicas, normas técnicas vigentes e regulamentos aplicáveis;

Responsabilidades:

Criar e desenvolver projetos de instalações elétricas, incluindo diagramas unifilares, dimensionamento de cabos, quadros de distribuição e sistemas de aterramento;

Produzir e revisar toda a documentação técnica necessária para a execução do projeto, incluindo plantas, esquemas elétricos, especificações e relatórios;

Apoiar a equipe de execução durante a instalação das soluções projetadas, esclarecendo dúvidas técnicas e realizando ajustes conforme necessário para garantir a conformidade com os projetos;

Realizar estudos de viabilidade técnica e econômica, propondo alternativas e soluções para otimização de projetos sem comprometer a qualidade e a segurança;

Garantir que os projetos estejam em conformidade com as normas técnicas vigentes, além de atender às especificações e requisitos de segurança do cliente;

Assegurar que os projetos atendam aos padrões de qualidade, realizando verificações e revisões para evitar erros de execução;

Estamos em busca de talentos como você!

Se você se identifica com os desafios da vaga e quer contribuir em um ambiente colaborativo. Envie seu currículo e venha transformar o seu potencial em resultados!

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Inteligência Artificial - Sênior
description:
Descrição da vaga

A posição de AI Software Architect exige uma combinação de visão estratégica e expertise técnica em inteligência artificial, habilidades interpessoais e interesse em atuar próximo ao universo comercial. O foco está na construção de propostas assertivas durante a prospecção e no fortalecimento do relacionamento com clientes, garantindo soluções alinhadas às necessidades de negócio e escaláveis para o futuro.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Colaborar com o Arquiteto de Soluções AI para transformar demandas de negócios em modelos e pipelines de ML/IA escaláveis e eficientes.
  • Implementar modelos de IA, validando performance e garantindo integração nas arquiteturas existentes.
  • Desenvolver pipelines robustos de dados: coleta, processamento, treinamento e deploy de modelos.
  • Integrar soluções de IA em ambientes de produção, alinhando-se às melhores práticas de MLOps (monitoramento, automação e escalabilidade, conhecimento sobre MlFlow ou plataformas como AzureML ou Google VertexAI).
  • Trabalhar próximo ao time comercial e de produto para prototipar e validar propostas, com entregas iterativas e soluções centradas no cliente.
  • Participar ativamente na avaliação de riscos técnicos (performance, escalabilidade, segurança) e colaborar na aplicação de soluções preventivas.
  • Garantir o uso eficiente de ferramentas cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) no desenvolvimento e deploy de soluções.
  • Colaborar na criação de documentação técnica e melhores práticas em alinhamento com o arquiteto e outros stakeholders.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento e deploy de modelos de Machine Learning e Deep Learning.
  • Domínio de linguagens de programação como Python (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Pandas).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de MLOps e CI/CD (MLflow, Kubeflow, Jenkins, GitLab CI).
  • Sólida experiência com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL e práticas de otimização de consultas.
  • Experiência com serviços cloud computing (AWS, Azure ou GCP) e containers (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiaridade com arquiteturas de sistemas, pipelines de dados e boas práticas de integração de APIs (REST, GraphQL).

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com AI Generativa e modelos LLMs (ex.: GPT, BERT).
  • Experiência com orquestração em nuvem com ferramentas como airflow, data factory, Databricks pipelines.
  • Experiência em com Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes ou ferramentas como Azure Container Apps (ou relativas).
  • Vivência em ambientes com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Experiência colaborando em projetos com arquitetos de soluções ou times comerciais.

  • Atuar na identificação, mapeamento e prospecção ativa de talentos para posições técnicas (Desenvolvimento, QA, DevOps, Data, etc.);
  • Utilizar estratégias avançadas de sourcing;
  • Criar e manter pipelines de talentos atualizados e segmentados por senioridade, tecnologia e região;
  • Conduzir primeiros contatos com candidatos, apresentando a oportunidade e avaliando o fit inicial;
  • Alimentar e manter atualizadas as informações no ATS e LinkedIn Recruiter;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o(a) Tech Recruiter e a liderança para alinhar perfis e prioridades de busca;
  • Contribuir com relatórios de funil de recrutamento e métricas de conversão;
  • Apoiar ações de employer branding e engajamento de talentos.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência prévia como Sourcer, Talent Researcher ou Recrutador com foco em tecnologia;
  • Vivência com vagas de diferentes países;
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de busca e automação (LinkedIn Recruiter, AmazingHiring, SeekOut, HireEZ, etc.);
  • Experiência com buscas booleanas;
  • Capacidade analítica e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal, com foco em relacionamento e abordagem personalizada.

A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. title: Data Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for "Data Engineer" Remote mode,who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

  • Snowflake, DBT, SQL
  • Proficient in English
  • Agile Methodologies;
  • Operational Monitoring: Proactively monitor data jobs and pipelines to ensure smooth execution and timely delivery of datasets. Respond to alerts and resolve issues with minimal downtime.
  • Pipeline Maintenance: Maintain and enhance DBT models and SQL scripts to support evolving business needs and ensure data accuracy.
  • Warehouse Operations: Oversee Snowflake operations including user access, query performance, and resource utilization.
  • Incident Response: Act as a first responder for data job failures, conducting root cause analysis and implementing preventive measures.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with data engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to support operational data needs and troubleshoot issues.
  • Process Optimization: Identify opportunities to automate manual tasks, improve pipeline efficiency, and reduce operational overhead.
  • Documentation & Reporting: Maintain clear documentation of operational procedures, job schedules, and incident logs. Provide regular updates to stakeholders on system health and performance.

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

#Buildingonbelief

title: Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor Role
description:
Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor

Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela

About Downstream

Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.

We're inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we're pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.

The Role

We're hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You've shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.

At Downstream, you'll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.

Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.

What We're Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You've shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don't just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder's DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You've felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.

Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.
  • Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.
  • Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn't seen this level of innovation before.
  • Competitive salary + equity

title: Desenvolvedor Salesforce
description:
Alô Linkedin! Estamos com vagas disponíveis para você na TAAK!

Estamos recrutando um Desenvolvedor Salesforce para integrar nossa equipe na TAAK. Se você tem paixão por programação e deseja trabalhar com uma das plataformas de CRM mais avançadas do mercado, essa vaga é ideal para você!

Desenvolvedor Salesforce (Remoto)

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e customizar aplicações na plataforma Salesforce.
  • Implementar soluções técnicas de alta qualidade para atender às necessidades dos clientes.
  • Colaborar com consultores e arquitetos para desenhar soluções eficientes.
  • Manter-se atualizado com as novas funcionalidades e atualizações da plataforma Salesforce.

Requisitos:

  • Formação em áreas relacionadas à tecnologia, como Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou afins.
  • Conhecimento em alguma linguagem de programação orientada a objetos (Java, C#, etc.).
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento na plataforma Salesforce, incluindo Apex, Visualforce e Lightning Components.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento Apex na plataforma Salesforce (automação, controladores, processos assíncronos)
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de interfaces visuais no Salesforce, utilizando VisualForce Pages, Aura Components, Lightning Web Components (LWC)
  • Experiência com integração de APIs, desenvolvimento de serviços web e API's padrão Salesforce
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de testes unitários
  • Certificações Salesforce.

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento web (HTML, CSS, JavaScript).
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento mobile (Cordova, React Native, Flutter, Kotlin, etc.).
  • Experiência com Lightning Web Components (LWC) para desenvolvimento moderno em Salesforce.
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento mobile utilizando frameworks como Node.js, Cordova, React Native, Flutter, ou Kotlin.
  • Experiência com integração de APIs e serviços web no Salesforce.
  • Familiaridade com DevOps e automação de processos no ambiente Salesforce.
  • Experiência com o desenvolvimento de aplicativos mobile utilizando a Salesforce Mobile SDK.

title: Assistente de Implantação
description:
A Convergint é uma empresa global, fundada em 2001 nos arredores de Chicago, que atua como integradora de sistemas especializada em segurança eletrônica, automação predial, áudio e vídeo, sistemas de incêndio e life safety, com objetivo de ser o melhor provedor de serviços para os nossos clientes.

Atualmente, contamos com mais de 11 mil colaboradores e estamos presentes em mais de 225 escritórios ao redor do mundo.

Descritivo:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Assistente de Implantação, responsável pela execução de atividades de infraestrutura e instalação de equipamentos eletrônicos, garantindo a qualidade, segurança e conformidade com os padrões internos da empresa.

Principais Atividades:

  • Passagem de cabos de dados e elétricos em tubulações, canaletas e caixas de passagem para interligação de equipamentos, painéis e dispositivos eletrônicos realizando trabalhos em altura (NR35)
  • Fixação de dispositivos e equipamentos (cameras, sensores, dispositivos eletrônicos, sonofletores, vídeo monitores, etc)
  • Disponibilidade de viagem para atender projetos em outros estados, seguindo a política de viagens estabelecido pela empresa.
  • Conhecer, entender e seguir as políticas e procedimentos do Sistema de Gestão da Convergint com foco em qualidade, Segurança da Informação Privacidade e Compliance / Antissuborno.
  • Propor melhorias para os processos e serviços visando manter e melhorar continuamente a Qualidade dos serviços, Segurança da Informação e Privacidade e Compliance / Antissuborno, incluindo participação na identificação e determinação de ações para minimização e controle dos riscos relacionados.
  • Encaminhar para os responsáveis qualquer evento ou incidente de Segurança da Informação ou Privacidade.

Conhecimentos:

  • Manuseio de ferramentas elétricas (parafusadeira, furadeira, esmerilhadeira)
  • Conectorização de cabos (RJ45, Keystone, P2, P10, DB9, Terminais elétricos)

title: Keeta-Partner Operation Strategy Manager 合作商质量控制策略运营
description:
Responsibilities:

1. Responsible for formulating the partner quality control strategy to ensure that the operational quality of partners meets the standards.

2. Take charge of establishing and optimizing the partner quality evaluation system, designing a hierarchical exit mechanism, and collaborating with frontline teams to promptly replace inferior partners.

3. Coordinate various departments such as frontline teams, assessment and pricing teams, and partner management teams to ensure that the exit process is reasonable and risks are controllable.

Requirements:

1. A bachelor's degree or above, with no restrictions on majors.

2. Candidates with more than 3 years of experience in Platform Governence, business analysis, 3PL management, etc. will be given priority.

3. Strong data analysis and communication - coordination skills are required. Candidates with experience in building incentive systems and scoring systems, as well as those with SQL skills, will be preferred.

4. Relevant work experience in formulating fulfillment and delivery strategies, rider management, etc. is required. Familiarity with fulfillment and delivery management under the crowdsourcing and franchise models is also required.

5. Proficiency in English, which should be used as the working language.

title: Franchise Business Consultant - LATAM
description:
The Franchise Business Consultant – LATAM supports Master Franchise and Direct Franchise partners across Latin America by providing operational guidance, financial coaching, and training to drive performance while ensuring alignment with Gold's Gym global standards. This role requires fluency in Portuguese and English and proficiency in Spanish to effectively collaborate across diverse markets in the region. The FBC conducts regular market visits, virtual consultations, and leads both in-person and online training sessions. This is a remote role based out of the Brasil. Frequent travel throughout Latin America—up to 50% or more—is required.

Responsibilities:

Franchise Support & Coaching

  • Serve as the primary operational liaison for Master Franchise and Direct Franchise owners, offering consultative support on day-to-day operations, financial performance, leadership development, and member experience.
  • Build strong, collaborative relationships across culturally and linguistically diverse markets, ensuring business strategies align with Gold's Gym standards while adapting to local market needs.
  • Conduct regular check-ins and annual in-person site visits with each franchise location in the assigned LATAM territory.
  • Provide guidance and resources to drive operational excellence and regional growth.
  • Leverage KPI benchmarks, and digital platforms to monitor and support franchise performance.

Training & Leadership Development

  • Develop and deliver in-person and virtual training sessions in Portuguese (and Spanish where applicable) for franchisees and their teams, focusing on operational efficiency, member experience, and profitability.
  • Facilitate webinars, learning sessions, and peer collaboration forums to promote continuous learning and knowledge sharing in the LATAM market.
  • Lead onboarding programs for new franchisees and gym leaders, providing a strong foundation in Gold's Gym systems, standards, and growth strategies.
  • Champion the rollout of corporate initiatives, tools, and new programs, ensuring cultural adaptation and consistent adoption across locations.

Operational Evaluations & Brand Standards

  • Perform standardized gym evaluations, operational audits, and brand assessments.
  • Ensure all LATAM locations remain compliant with system standards, brand guidelines, and operational policies.

Strategic Business & Financial Planning

  • Review and interpret financial reports (P&Ls, balance sheets, KPIs) to identify trends and coach franchisees on strategies for profitability and operational improvement.
  • Assist with strategic planning, forecasting, and staff planning tailored to the LATAM region.

Market Insights & System Collaboration

  • Conduct annual market reviews and monitor competitive activity in each territory.
  • Share benchmarking data, performance insights, and market intelligence with both franchisees and internal teams.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, technology, and development teams to align LATAM field strategies with broader corporate objectives.

Skills & Qualifications

  • Fluency in Portuguese, English and Spanish required.
  • 3 to 5 years of experience in franchise operations, business consulting, or multi-unit fitness/hospitality management.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Exercise Science, or a related field preferred.
  • Proven ability to lead both in-person and virtual training programs in multiple languages.
  • Strong knowledge of fitness industry operations, financial drivers, and customer experience best practices.
  • Exceptional communication, facilitation, and coaching skills, with a high degree of cultural intelligence.
  • Basic knowledge of gym technology platforms is a plus.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% or more across Latin America and Caribbean, including overnight travel and weekends when necessary.

Preferred Attributes

  • Passion for fitness, health, and wellness.
  • Experience supporting international franchise or multi-unit business models, particularly in Latin America.
  • Strong presence and confidence when leading groups and delivering training in culturally diverse environments.
  • High level of business acumen, adaptability, and emotional intelligence.
  • Familiarity with Gold's Gym tools, systems, or service providers.

title: Analista Treinamento e Desenvolvimento Pleno/Senior
description:
Estamos em busca de Analista de Treinamento e Desenvolvimento Pleno/Sênior para integrar o time de Performance e Cultura da AI/R Company, grupo que reúne empresas como Avenue Code, Invillia e Compass UOL. Essa posição tem como propósito impulsionar o desenvolvimento das pessoas e fortalecer a cultura organizacional em um ambiente dinâmico, inovador e orientado a resultados. Você será responsável por desenhar e implementar iniciativas estratégicas de aprendizagem e desenvolvimento, apoiar programas de performance e liderança, e atuar de forma consultiva junto às áreas de negócio.

Responsabilidades:

  • Mapear e analisar necessidades de treinamento junto às lideranças e áreas de negócio;
  • Planejar, estruturar e executar programas de desenvolvimento técnico, comportamental e de liderança;
  • Desenvolver conteúdos e trilhas de aprendizagem (presenciais, online e híbridos);
  • Gerenciar indicadores e relatórios de eficácia dos programas de T&D;
  • Apoiar iniciativas de gestão de performance, plano de desenvolvimento individual (PDI) e sucessão;
  • Conduzir trilhas de desenvolvimento de carreira
  • Atuar como parceiro(a) estratégico(a) de RH, contribuindo para o fortalecimento da cultura organizacional e do engajamento das equipes.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Formação superior completa em Psicologia, Administração, Recursos Humanos, Pedagogia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia sólida em Treinamento e Desenvolvimento,
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de aprendizagem, gestão por competências e ferramentas de avaliação;
  • Experiência com desenho instrucional e facilitação de treinamentos;
  • Domínio de ferramentas digitais de aprendizagem e plataformas LMS;
  • Habilidade para análise de indicadores e elaboração de planos de ação.
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado para conversação.

A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. Por se tratar de uma empresa de consultoria, a Avenue Code poderá compartilhar suas informações com seus clientes e com outras empresas do Grupo CompassUol, às quais os(as) consultores(as) da Avenue Code estejam alocados para a prestação de serviços.

title: Pessoa Engenheira Backend Sênior & Engenheira Fullstack Sênior
description:
Estamos contratando: Pessoa Engenheira Backend E Fullstack Sênior!

Você é apaixonado(a) por construir sistemas robustos, escaláveis e de alta performance? Curte trabalhar com arquitetura moderna, boas práticas e tecnologias de ponta? Então vem com a gente

Estamos com duas oportunidades incríveis para integrar nosso cliente de engenharia — uma focada em Backend Sênior e outra em Fullstack Sênior.

Pessoa Engenheira Backend Sênior

Buscamos alguém com sólida experiência em Laravel (PHP 8+), arquitetura limpa e escalável (DDD, SOLID, Clean Architecture), e domínio em APIs RESTful e GraphQL.

Você vai trabalhar com:

  • Eloquent ORM, queues, jobs, middlewares e containers de serviço;
  • Bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL) e NoSQL (Redis, MongoDB, ElasticSearch);
  • Autenticação e segurança de APIs (OAuth 2.0, JWT, Passport, Sanctum);
  • Testes automatizados e práticas de qualidade;
  • Infraestrutura e deploy com Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI);
  • Observabilidade, monitoramento e cloud (AWS, GCP).

Pessoa Engenheira Fullstack

Procuramos alguém versátil, que transite bem entre frontend e backend, com foco em JavaScript / TypeScript.

Você vai trabalhar com:

  • Frontend: Nuxt.js, Angular ou React.js — usando HTML, CSS (Grid, Flexbox) e TailwindCSS;
  • Backend: NestJS ou Express;
  • Arquiteturas modernas (monolitos e microserviços);
  • Integrações via APIs REST e GraphQL;
  • Autenticação e autorização (OAuth, JWT);
  • Bancos SQL e NoSQL;
  • Deploys em nuvem (AWS, GCP, DigitalOcean), monitoramento e GitHub.

O que valorizamos

  • Mentalidade colaborativa e foco em entrega de valor;
  • Código limpo, sustentável e bem testado;
  • Curiosidade técnica e vontade de aprender continuamente;
  • Autonomia e responsabilidade técnica.

Local e formato

Atuação remota, com um time distribuído e conectado. E contrantação PJ!

Como se candidatar

Se você se identifica com um desses perfis, envie seu currículo, GitHub ou portfólio — queremos te conhecer!

title: Senior Full-Stack (Flutter + NestJS) Engineer
description:
Senior Full-Stack (Flutter + NestJS) Engineer

Summary

We're looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to help one of our partners build and scale their e-commerce platform. This is a hands-on role for someone who's passionate about creating high-performing, user-friendly applications across both mobile and web. You'll be working with Flutter on the frontend and NestJS on the backend, collaborating with a cross-functional team to deliver quality code and seamless user experiences.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable full-stack solutions using Flutter and NestJS.
  • Collaborate with product, design, and backend teams to deliver features end-to-end.
  • Write clean, testable, and maintainable code with a focus on performance and security.
  • Participate in code reviews, architectural discussions, and technical decisions.
  • Contribute to improving development processes and best practices within the team.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Strong experience with Flutter for cross-platform mobile or web apps.
  • Proven expertise with NestJS and Node.js for backend services.
  • Solid understanding of RESTful APIs, authentication, and modern cloud architectures.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Git-based workflows.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in collaborative, remote teams.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with e-commerce platforms or payment integrations.
  • Experience with TypeScript and microservices architecture.
  • Knowledge of containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).

title: Application Administrator
description:
About OSF Digital:

OSF Digital is a leading global digital transformation company, operating in over 30 countries worldwide. As a Salesforce Partner, we specialize in providing innovative solutions to help businesses achieve their digital goals. We are proud to be the only global Salesforce partner recognized in the top 5 categories, highlighting our commitment to excellence and customer success. With a strong focus on leveraging cutting-edge technologies and industry best practices, our team of experts is dedicated to driving growth and efficiency for our clients across various industries. Embracing a 100% remote culture for over 20 years, we are committed to flexibility and work-life balance for our employees.

We are seeking a dedicated Application Administrator to join our team. OSF Digital is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, where you can bring your whole self to work. Join an inclusive and passionate community of professionals who help bring about digital transformation for businesses around the world. At OSF Digital, we welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, or any other protected category in any of the jurisdictions in which we conduct business.

Responsibilities:

  • Configuration of Email Studio, Journey Builder, and Automation Studio.
  • Creation and management of Data Streams, DMOs, and Segments in Data Cloud.
  • Integration with Salesforce Core, App/Site, and SFTP.
  • Support in data modeling, identity unification, and data-driven automations.
  • Troubleshooting and implementation of best practices in deliverability and governance.

Requirements:

  • Proven experience in SFMC and Data Cloud.
  • Knowledge of SQL, Data Views, and integrations.

Nice to Have:

  • Salesforce Certifications (Email Specialist, Marketing Cloud Admin, or Data Cloud Consultant).
  • English or Spanish can be a bonus.

title: Game Designer (Mid to Senior)
description:
Location: Remote (Brazil-based)

Employment type: Full-time (CLT)

Language: Portuguese (fluent), English (professional working proficiency)

Salary Range: R$7K – R$12K

762 Interactive is looking for a Game Designer to join our studio and help bring to life Project Kingpin, an ambitious and fresh take on crime-strategy and management games. We're searching for someone with strong gameplay instincts, creative systems thinking, and a passion for designing mechanics that are strategic, rewarding, and authentic. You'll work across gameplay systems, economy, and progression to shape how players experience the world we are building. This role requires both hands-on design work and collaboration across disciplines.

This is a remote position.

Please do not apply if you do not have prior game development experience.

In This Role You Will:

  • Design and document core gameplay systems, loops, and progression structures.
  • Balance player rewards, pacing, and progression using data and playtesting.
  • Write and maintain clear design documentation (GDDs, feature briefs, tuning sheets).
  • Collaborate closely with developers, artists, and production to prototype and refine mechanics.
  • Participate in playtests and iterate based on player feedback.
  • Contribute ideas across mission design, economy systems, and player experience.
  • Help define design processes and best practices as part of a growing studio.

What We are Looking For:

  • 3+ years of professional experience in game design.
  • Proven experience with gameplay systems, progression, or balancing.
  • Strong analytical thinking and ability to translate creative ideas into testable mechanics.
  • Proficiency with Excel/Sheets for tuning and balancing.
  • Knowledge of Unity editor & autonomy to use the scriptable objects
  • Clear, structured writing and documentation skills.
  • Can think and work creatively while taking the initiative to solve problems.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-discipline.
  • Self-motivated, strong work ethic, and able to work independently.
  • Drive towards professional growth.
  • Fluent in Portuguese; English proficiency for daily communication with U.S. leadership.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with strategy / sim / management games is very welcome.
  • UI/UX Design Experience.
  • Knowledge of C# in the Unity Engine.
  • Knowledge of AI behavior, or mission scripting.
  • Understanding of Unity implementation or prototyping workflows.
  • Interest in narrative-driven systems or branching gameplay.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary
  • CLT Contract with Benefits (including Health Insurance, Monthly Meal Voucher, & Monthly Internet / Home Office Voucher)
  • Remote-first culture
  • Clear growth path: opportunities to advance your career as we scale the team and build the studio.
  • Opportunity to shape the foundation of the studio and game from the ground up.
  • Creative environment where your voice and ideas matter.

BRQ WAY

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel)

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.

Position Overview:

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will play a key role in the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions to support the company's mission and goals. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.

Primary Responsibilities:

1. Platform Development: Spearhead the development and optimization of

our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel, ensuring high performance,

reliability, and scalability.

2. Database Development: Creating database schemas that represent and

support business processes

3. API Development and Integration: Develop and maintain APIs for internal

and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare

systems and third-party services.

4. Security Compliance: Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare

industry standards, including HIPAA, by implementing and maintaining

robust security measures and data protection protocols.

Additional Responsibilities:

1. Mentor junior developers, providing guidance on best practices in

backend development, code review, and team collaboration.

2. Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to

continually innovate and enhance the platform.

3. Participate in the agile development process, contributing to sprint

planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, ensuring timely delivery of

high-quality software.

4. Collaborate with the design team to refine the platform's user interface

and experience, implementing responsive and intuitive front-end

functionalities using modern JavaScript frameworks.

Competencies/Requirements:

1. Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL.

Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git.

2. Experience: At least 5 years of experience in backend development, with a

proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web

applications. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is

highly desirable.

3. Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to tackle complex problems, think

analytically, and develop innovative solutions.

4. Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills,

capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and

stakeholders.

5. Attention to Detail: A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design

specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and

efficient platform.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth

Applications will only be considered with CVs submitted in English.

title: Customer Success Specialist
description:
• LOVE startups and always dreamed of working in tech?
  • WANT to build meaningful relationships and help ambitious entrepreneurs succeed?
  • BELIEVE you can use initiative and ownership to fast-track your career?

    • THEN READ ON!

    Oneday is an education technology platform designed to inspire and equip aspiring entrepreneurs from diverse backgrounds to turn their business dreams into reality.

    Backed by $15M in seed funding from top-tier VCs in the UK and Silicon Valley, Oneday is scaling fast. Our mission: redefine business education and become the largest entrepreneurship school in the world.

    Join us and help shape a world where anyone, anywhere, can build a company.

    WHAT IS THIS ROLE ABOUT?

    We are hiring an entrepreneurial Customer Success Specialist who will own the student experience end-to-end. Your mission is to wow our students, keep them deeply engaged, and ensure they achieve real outcomes through the program.

    You will be part relationship-builder, part problem-solver, part coach. You will collaborate closely with our admissions, mentor, and product teams — acting as the voice of the customer inside Oneday.

    This is NOT a routine support role. This is a high-ownership, fast-paced, startup CS role for someone who wants to grow fast.

    WHAT YOU'LL DO

    • Build strong relationships with students and mentors to ensure a world-class experience
    • Monitor student progress and proactively increase engagement, satisfaction, and completion
    • Identify blockers and help students stay motivated and on track
    • Run check-ins, onboarding sessions, and community touchpoints
    • Turn feedback into insights to improve the product and operations
    • Drive retention, NPS and student outcomes as your core KPIs
    • Contribute to building scalable CS processes as we grow

    WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

    • Fluent English speaker with exceptional communication skills
    • Entrepreneurial mindset — you take initiative, move fast, and solve problems without waiting for instructions
    • High empathy + relationship skills (you enjoy speaking with people daily)
    • Ownership mentality — you think in outcomes, not tasks
    • A passion for business, startups, or education is a big plus

title: Gerente imobiliário
description:
A Águia Está em Expansão – Vem Voar Alto Conosco!

Na Águia Consultoria Imobiliária, celebramos 13 anos de conquistas extraordinárias, com mais de R$ 4 bilhões em VGV comercializados. Nosso time não para de crescer, batendo recordes de vendas e superando expectativas. Se você busca crescimento rápido, desafios diários e um ambiente de alta performance, essa é sua chance de fazer parte de um time vencedor!

Gerente Imobiliário – PJ

Curitiba, PR – Presencial

Estamos em busca de um Gerente Imobiliário para liderar a operação comercial local, com foco em captação de imóveis, desenvolvimento da equipe e crescimento das vendas.

Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar, treinar e acompanhar o desempenho da equipe de corretores;
  • Estruturar processos comerciais e garantir o atingimento de metas de captação e vendas;
  • Atuar diretamente na negociação com proprietários, investidores e compradores;
  • Implementar estratégias para aumento de produtividade e qualidade no atendimento;
  • Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho e propor ações de melhoria contínua;
  • Representar a unidade perante clientes e diretoria.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência anterior com gestão de pessoas e mercado imobiliário;
  • Capacidade de liderança, organização e foco em metas;
  • Conhecimento em captação, negociação e fechamento de vendas;
  • Registro no CRECI ativo (obrigatório).

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
Join OSF Digital as a Backend Developer, where you will design and build server-side components using Java, ensuring clean and efficient code. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize backend performance and security while contributing to innovative digital experiences for our users.

Job Description

  • Backend Development:

Design and build server-side components, including APIs and databases, using Java and relevant frameworks, ensuring clean and maintainable code.

  • API Work:

Implement and integrate RESTful APIs, manage data validation, and handle errors, possibly integrating with external services.

  • Database Management:

Design and optimize databases for performance, maintain data integrity, and work with various database systems.

  • Testing & QA:

Conduct unit and integration tests to maintain code quality, identify bugs, and optimize performance.

  • Team Collaboration:

Engage with cross-functional teams to meet project goals, requiring strong communication and teamwork skills.

Technical Competencies:

  • Java Programming:

Strong knowledge and experience in the Java programming language. Understanding of core concepts, syntax, and best practices.

  • Server-Side Development:

Experience in building server-side applications and APIs using Java frameworks such as Spring Boot.

  • Relational Databases:

Proficiency in working with relational databases like MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Oracle. Knowledge of SQL, data modeling, and database optimization.

  • Web Development:

Understanding of web development concepts and technologies such as RESTful APIs, JSON, and XML.

  • Java Frameworks and Libraries:

Familiarity with popular Java frameworks and libraries such as Spring Framework, Hibernate, or Apache Kafka.

  • Unit Testing:

Experience with unit testing frameworks like JUnit. Knowledge of software testing principles and practices.

  • Version Control:

Proficiency in using version control systems like Git for code management and collaboration.

Analytical and Problem-Solving Competencies:

  • Analytical Skills:

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify and resolve issues in the backend code and infrastructure.

  • Performance Optimization:

Knowledge of performance optimization techniques, such as caching, indexing, and query optimization, to ensure efficient and scalable backend systems.

Cloud Experience:

  • Cloud Services:

Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS. Ability to deploy and manage applications in a cloud environment, leveraging cloud services for scalability and performance.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Judi is a U.S.-based healthcare technology company that provides pharmacy benefit management (PBM) services. Their focus is on making prescription drug pricing more transparent and affordable for employers, health plans, and patients.

Join our mission to transform our nation's healthcare system as a Senior Full-stack Software Developer. In this role, you will assist in leading projects from design to delivery. Partner with product managers and designers to define requirements during discovery and planning. Collaborate with developers to deliver those requirements on time as new features or improvements to existing functionality.

Why You'll Love Working Here

  • We have a remote-first culture.
  • You will make a tangible impact on society. Your code will directly improve healthcare experiences for millions.
  • We are a late-stage startup with stability. We have startup energy with a focus on delivery, but healthy processes with a strong financial outlook that provides a sense of security.

Position Responsibilities

In this role, you'll combine technical leadership with hands-on coding to build scalable, high-impact healthcare technology. You will:

  • Exercise leadership over features from design to delivery.
  • Be a partner to product, design, and quality assurance team members.
  • Become a subject matter expert on your team's products.
  • Provide technical support to cross-functional team members and stakeholders.
  • Expand Judi, our web-based enterprise health platform, using Python, AWS services, React/Typescript, and other technologies.
  • Work in an Agile/Scrum environment.

Preferred Qualifications

We're looking for someone who brings a mix of technical expertise, problem-solving ability, and collaborative spirit:

  • 7+ years of job-related experience.
  • Desire to work at a health tech company.
  • Strong Python (Flask / SQLAlchemy) and React / Typescript experience.
  • Advanced PostgreSQL database knowledge (e.g., common table expressions, windowing functions, views, stored procedures, full-text or geospatial indexing).
  • Experience with infrastructure as code using AWS, Terraform, or similar technologies.
  • Experience writing unit and integration tests.
  • Git expertise and experience working in a mono repo.
  • Able to demonstrate agency, urgency, and ownership over delivering quality work.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Previous Pharmacy Benefits Manager (PBM) experience is a plus.

What You Get:

  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team;
  • Unlimited PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule;
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences;
  • Health/Sport budget
  • Remote work.

This position description is designed to be flexible, allowing management the opportunity to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities as needed to best meet organizational goals.

title: Content Writer
description:
Job Description:

We are seeking highly analytical and detail-oriented professionals with hands-on experience in Red Teaming, Prompt Evaluation, and AI/LLM Quality Assurance. The ideal candidate will help us rigorously test and evaluate AI-generated content to identify vulnerabilities, assess risks, and ensure compliance with safety, ethical, and quality standards.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct Red Teaming exercises to identify adversarial, harmful, or unsafe outputs from large language models (LLMs).
  • Evaluate and stress-test AI prompts across multiple domains (e.g., finance, healthcare, security) to uncover potential failure modes.
  • Develop and apply test cases to assess accuracy, bias, toxicity, hallucinations, and misuse potential in AI-generated responses.
  • Collaborate with data scientists, safety researchers, and prompt engineers to report risks and suggest mitigations.
  • Perform manual QA and content validation across model versions, ensuring factual consistency, coherence, and guideline adherence.
  • Create evaluation frameworks and scoring rubrics for prompt performance and safety compliance.
  • Document findings, edge cases, and vulnerability reports with high clarity and structure.

Requirements:

  • Proven experience in AI red teaming, LLM safety testing, or adversarial prompt design.
  • Familiarity with prompt engineering, NLP tasks, and ethical considerations in generative AI.
  • Strong background in Quality Assurance, content review, or test case development for AI/ML systems.
  • Understanding of LLM behaviors, failure modes, and model evaluation metrics.
  • Excellent critical thinking, pattern recognition, and analytical writing skills.
  • Ability to work independently, follow detailed evaluation protocols, and meet tight deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior work with teams like OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, or other LLM safety initiatives.
  • Experience in risk assessment, red team security testing, or AI policy & governance.

Background in linguistics, psychology, or computational ethics is a plus.

Next Steps

To proceed further in the evaluation process, you will need to complete two assessments:

  • Assessment Test
  • Evaluates your linguistic and analytical skills
  • Link:
  • Versant English Proficiency Test
  • Focuses on assessing your spoken and written English proficiency
  • A C1 or C2 level is required to qualify

Once both assessments are successfully completed, you will be eligible for onboarding.

  • Language test

Action Required: XConnect Registration

You will also receive an invitation to our internal job platform, XConnect. Please take a few minutes to register and complete your profile. All project onboarding, communication, and documentation are managed through this platform.

If interested, kindly share your resume at:
